reviews.text: It is the worst place you could take your pet; I recommend taking it anywhere but there. Good luck.

I've been going there with my babies for many years; it's a very good place and the price is very good.
I take both of my dogs there and they get their shots and they get treated well he’s a reasonable priced. He’s a great doctor. He really is. He is a caring doctor for the pets

Dr. Bhaskar is an amazing veterinarian, and I can’t recommend him and his team enough. We brought our 8-year-old Shih Tzu, Moshi, in for a tumor removal, and from the very beginning, Dr. Bhaskar showed an incredible sense of urgency. He even prioritized Moshi’s surgery on a day he doesn’t normally perform surgeries because of the urgency.

Throughout the entire process, Dr. Bhaskar treated both Moshi and our family with genuine compassion, kindness, and reassurance. His level of care made what could have been a very stressful experience so much easier.

The entire staff was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and incredibly accommodating. I especially want to recognize the front desk receptionist with the tattoos and lip piercings. She went above and beyond with communication, worked with us to accommodate our pickup time, and made sure we were informed every step of the way. Her kindness and professionalism truly stood out.

On top of the exceptional care, the pricing was more than fair, which made the experience even better. We are beyond grateful to Dr. Bhaskar and his entire team for taking such wonderful care of Moshi. This was an outstanding experience from start to finish, and we would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, quality veterinary care.
He is the best vet you will ever find. He is well knowledgeable, considerate just a wonderful place to go and have your pets taken care of Staff is wonderful, very helpful. Pricing is very fair.
I love this place so much because I know they are not going to blow me off when I need a dog park pass.

I had a good experience at this clinic. The Dr is very sweet & the receptionists are also very caring. Prices are pretty affordable. I was hesitant because you have to be in line early but I don't regret it. I was happy when I left.
I trust this vet with all my animal pets.  I have cats and dogs and never had an issue.  Recommend. You must visit.
Great local small business is 1st come 1st serve.

I haven't been here since 2018, but I always recommend this place to anyone in Chicago. I'm not a local, but this clinic is by far the best in terms of price, and the veterinarian is excellent as well.

I always recommend this clinic when people are looking for something affordable. I found it incredibly cheap when my dog ​​was bitten by a mouse when he had a fever. This was years ago, but I still think it's one of the best clinics.
The staff is friendly and helpful. Dr. Bhaskar has cared for our Yorkies for many years now. We always know that they are in good hands. This place goes above and beyond. Highly recommend.
Hes been there for all 4 of my dogs and 3 till the very end of their lives. Hes treated them and cared for them just right. Wont go to anyone else.

I came in today after messaging the staff on Facebook messenger and they told me that I could bring my dog on Saturday at 10:30 for nails with sedation. I told them my dog is really reactive when he gets his nails trimmed and pulls away which is why we wanted the sedation option. In the facebook messages they confirmed and gave me pricing. I show up on Saturday at 10:30 like I was told and they proceeded to tell me that they dont do sedations on Saturdays and will attempt to cut his nails without it and if he cant handle it then we gad to reschedule it and come on a weekday. I stayed because I still wanted my dog to get his rabies vaccine as well. Once we get called to come back in, the doctor takes one look at my dog and says underneath his mask, “What the hell is that?”. I had mentioned to them before my dog is a lab mix and he is big which is why we didnt wait in the lobby and the receptionist said it was fine to wait out in the car and theyd call me when theyre ready. They took us to the room and could not get him on the exam table. They put the muzzle on him and then tried cutting with nail clippers which I had already said he would not allow because he pulls away. When the doctor tried to cut his nail, my dog pulled away and his nail bled. That is why I even went in the first place because he has had this issue before and yet even after hearing my concerns he tried to cut them and made my dog bleed. After that moment I said to not cut them anymore and we would just be accepting the rabies shot. The rabies shot went fine no problem. We paid and said we would call some other time to have him get the nails cut while being sedated.

If you want a decent priced place then this place is good because it was not too expensive. However, if you have a big dog thats more than 120 lbs, (mine is approximately 150-160 lbs) definitely look elsewhere because they will not accommodate for them for certain issues. Some reviews you will see on Google and Yelp have pictures of big dogs which is why I came here in the first place but I think they no longer accommodate to them based off of our experience today.)

My first time there today with my cat Oreo. The staff and doctor, all very professional, friendly and knowledgeable. They are indeed very carrying with all animals. While I was waiting in the room, they brought in someone’s cat that was dropped off to be neutered. The doctor’s assistant was petting it and talking to it so lovingly, that I thought it was her own cat and even asked her if it was. So, for those of you dropping off your pets there, know they’re very well taken care of. Anyway, I was very satisfied with my visit. The doctor was super gentle with the consultation. You can’t beat their prices and the doctor doesn’t push any unnecessary tests on you. I wish I could give more than 5 stars. Highly recommended!
I have had three dogs and they have done them justice!!!

I took my baby to this facility with some health concerns. After reading the reviews, I made sure to arrive early, and I was second in line when they opened.

Despite some initial apprehension, the staff and doctor were caring and efficient in addressing our needs.

If you’re smart you’ll get here early to get in line. Anytime I’ve been, clients have nothing but great things to say about their experience with the staff and vet. Prices are fair, staff is kind. It is first come first serve and the earlier you arrive (before 9:30a) the sooner you’re seen.
Dr. and staff are very nice and there is no price gouging.

Absolutely the best veterinarian in Chicago, Dr. Bathala and his team continue providing amazing animal care without the stiff price.

I've been taking our pets to him for over 10 years, and it is always a fraction of the cost compared to all other places in Chicago. Best of all, he will never do an unnecessary procedure.

Seligma Hospital is all about the love of animals and not profiting from unnecessary high prices.

There should be many more vets like Dr. Bathala.

I am forever grateful to you and your team.
